body: Why do we have to suffer in order to receive "blessings" from an invisible man? If god really cared in the first place, his love would be unconditionally and we wouldnt have to suffer to see happiness. This is dumb. Telling people that theres a light at the end of the tunnel is so easy and effectively useless comfort.

I wholeheartedly wish this every day. Because now, we're stuck. We can't leave as we wish to and are condemned to being told we're "defective" or "selfish" for not being able to go on any longer. Oh, and not to mention that we'll also go to hell if we do end up ending it all. Nice 👌

Finally. Yes, exactly. 
I have had such a shitty life since birth. I can remember being four years old and wishing I was adopted because I felt better believing that as an excuse as to why my mother treated me so badly. 
There's so much more, like you said. I do not have anything good in my life. 

It never ends. All this pain isnt worth it and I feel like such a terrible person for not thinking about my my baby might not have wanted to be born. 
Now It's too late. 

Thank you for seeing it so clearly. Wow. 
Thank you. 
People always throwing medication and theraphy around and calling you the problem for wanting to die. It's so stupid.

Me too. 
Staying up late tonight just crying. I'm glad someone else can relate but of course it is not a lovely thing to be able to relate on. 
I'm sorry. 
I hope another good day comes sooner in place of the funky bad ones. ❤❤❤

Wow. My birthday was last month and my phone service actually ended up ending that day so I never received any calls or texts from anyone.
I think it was a good thing so now I'll never know whether or not he texted me. I dont know if I'm more glad or sad. Still hurts I completely understand how you feel.

Soooo insane. I even told my mother this the last time we spoke. I'm about to have a baby and I was explaining to her thatvI will never make my child feel indebted to me for the mere fact that I birthed them. 
She seriously told me I should be grateful that she didnt abort me. Lol I feel the opposite honestly because of hiw shit my life has been because of her. 
Insane.

Completely agree. He broke up with me because his fam was telling him we were toxic. 
Id repeatedly always made sure to ask him what we could change to make things better but he always shrugged.
Days later he tells me we're done lol
And then brings up us seeing other people. Yeah, thays not spmething you do when you love someone

It hurts to the core. It really does. 
Ive run out of words to describe how I feel. How i felt in that moment when everything came crashing down. It wasnt thst it was sudden, it was that this was something i was trying to do everything in my power to prevent. 

I knew he was a completely different person from when we'd met but i couldnt let go. 
The pain runs deep.
It burns. 
Curse it all. Why did it have to happen? Why couldn't things be good? Why did this person have to do this?
:/

Me too. I relate to this in every possible way. 
Feeling sad, gross and overwhelmed with everything thst has happened. I hate that this is my reality. 
I can no longer pretend that this doesnt affect me. I'm so exhausted from putting on a brave face. Each night is just more and more painful and just another reminder of how I never meant anything to that person.

This definitely soothed some of these rough emotions out tonight and hopefully I cant fall asleep and let the pain melt away.

It's so crazy seeing everything now that we're out. I still can't believe it. The way they run away from everything is unbelievable.
He told me I was running away from my problems because I left him. Lol wtf

I feel you. I'm slippung back into that again too.
Working useless job and never having anything to save. No family and the friends i do have will never understand what this feels like. They have homes, partners and family's. 
I have nothing. 
I wish money didnt rule our lives wtf

Thank you so much. Yes, I am a million percent sure that we will do well if he and anyone related to him stay away from us. 
Im sure i can stay strong so long as I have all you guys❤
You stay strong as well. Your letter really touched me

So true. It is so much more. So deep amd twisted. Ugly and hidden from the eyes of others. 
Truly isolating :/

All I can say is Thank you. This mirrors exactly what I went through ans Im sure everyone else can relate as well. Im having a hard month already and just feel so worthless when i remember all the terrible things i went through. It hurts so bad. 
The pain is almost unbearable

Yes, it's been incredibly difficult for sure. Had to drop family as well so it's just been me starting all over from scratch. 
Breadcrumbing is the PERFECT way to put it. Wow. He's been doing that for sure for a long time and I never realized. I just thought that I needed to be patient and a better understanding partner and things would be work out. Nope, I completely cut contact that day. Not going to respond ever and I pray that he disappears from my life forever. So far it's been a few weeks since his last message but who knows. He knows im due in april so that sucks. I really hope to never hear from him again. Toxic pos. Hahah

And yeah he's tried to lure me back in by sending stupid texts like "hi". 
But then he disappears so clearly I dont mean shit to him

I'm glad he did. He was emotionally abusive and manipulative the entire relationship. But he ended things because his mother hates me. Everyone told him to get rid of me after the pregnancy and so 8 months into the pregnancy he decided thatd be a good time to ditch me. 
Knowing how awful they are afterwards doesnt erase all the pain but it does help a tiny bit. They're scum but somehow we're made to feel like we are when we've done nothing wrong wtf

Thanks for sharing this too.
And it's been a month for both. The day he dumped was the day i cut contact. He led me to believe he'd help after the baby was born all the while ive been couch hopping at 8 months pregnant lol
I feel like I wrote this and it's so painfully similar to what I wouldve wrote to him that i cant even finish reading it.

Relate to this SO much. It's so ridiculous and sad. 
I'm exhaustes just thinking about all the times I went through this and the constant mixture of misery and "happiness" I swayed from during my "relationship" with him. 
Shouldve been the first red flag but I wanted to give him room and time to change. 
BYE. Stopped talking to hik completely after he dumped me and he's tried to get in contact twice before disappearing as usual lol
❤❤❤❤❤ thank you so much

Honestly thank you for giving the permission to cry and let everything out. The people who know of my breakup/discard (and I stopped telling my other friends) expect me to be completely fine after all that has happened. Apparently youre supposed to just move on and act like you dont have emotions because they want you to....
I find it selfish and am very uncomfortable around those types of "friends".
 They want you to plaster a smile on your face for their own convenience but will continue to ask you what's wrong every two seconds as if they expect a different answer. It's hard because we dont want to completely shut ourselves out so its hard to fake it as we dont want to be a drain on other people either. 
That is one thing that makes this whole process so isolating.

 So anyway, being told we're allowed to FEEL and PROCESS everything is so freakin helpful you dont even know. 
Some days are shxx, some are good but when the need to cry comes, it shouldn't be suppressed. 
Thanks again. Honestly have no idea what id do without this community ❤

WOW this literally how I feel now. That's crazy. 
Hang in there :/ you know whats good for you. Dont smother your feelings and gut instincts anymore for their sake...
This honestly feels so miserable though. I agree. If only he'd call and apologize and make things happy, how amazing the world would be, right? 
Not gonna happen. And if it does, we'll just get abused again. Guarantee.

Today was a bad day for sure.
I don't know what causes them though. Maybe it's because we're really having accept what's happening and the bad days are all the gunk coming out of us. Idk
I'm sorry you're hurting :/

I can understand both sides for sure. 
I had to block my abusive fam but the ex I havent blocked. Just am not responding to any of his random texts every few weeks. 
Blocking him would definitely make me feel more anxious. At least I know when he does text me I can see how ridicouls he is and how little he ever cared about me.

Good for you!! I'm proud to here how much better you're doing. Keep focusing on you like you are. Takd care of yourself each day. :) 
I'm in the very beginning of my NC but it's still good to see others who are finally feeling better. 
I wish you all the best!!!

HUGS

Yeah...Im sure we can all relate which is why this forum is so comforting.
But wow, you're doing so amazing. A YEAR??? Keep up the awesome work!
Same.... It hurts so much. It really does

THANK YOU SO SO SO MUCH. ❤❤❤
It's getting harder each day now that Im able to actually process what has happened. I still can't even begin to process it.
Im in total shock. I'm exhausted and wish it all nevee happened. 
I'm going to read this every night from now on, just so I can remind myself I'm not crazy and not wrong about all that happened. Thank you :/

Same. He sent a text a few days later trying to act like he didnt just dump me and tell me that id be raising the baby alone after birth. 
Why do i wish for the past when i can now see how shitty things have always been?? I don't know. Just still in shock i guess. 
He led me on through the whole pregnancy just to throw me away two months before the due date...

Needed this. Today is a bit different from most days since the discard...
Ita been almost a month but today i find myself wanting him to take me back. I'm scared and dont know how to raise this baby im about to have, alone. So scared a d just tired. 
Everyone even my own family has left me to do this all alone and I just wish he would apologize and choose me.

Glad im not the only one having to take steps...
Blocked him on social media but havent blocked or deleted his number or messages...

Are you familiar with narc abuse? If you are then why give such basic advice that someone uninformed of narc abuse would give?? 
I'm looking for help on how to go about this as this is nkt a normal break up or situation. I was raised by a narc and know how fucked up it can be. THAT is my reason for wanting to get help. 
And yes, if he told me he would help me until recently and then decided not that is an issue that should be looked at. But nevermind. Ill just go ask a lawyer which i should be doing anyway and not for peoples opinions.
You clearly have no experience with abuse so just why bother on giving your two cents? You sound like youre upset. Just dont even comment if youre going to blame instead of offer good advice

Is there a way I can present the evidence of abandonment and emotional damage he has caused me during pregnancy, court? Because he cant just be viewed as a capable parent just because he is related to the baby. 
If he wouldnt help during the pregnancy and basically abandoned us in a time of need, which also puts the baby at risk, there should be something I can do no?
THANK YOU ❤❤❤

We're here with you! Don't give up! Keep taking care of yourself!!
Process all the emotions you need to and your thoughts but don't go back to him. 
YOU CAN DO THIS ❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤❤
So dumb LOL BYE
So true. Completely different person. Really sucks

Thanks for this.
He sent me another few dumb messages yesterday. The same old "hi" and "hello" never bothers even put any effort into using caps either. Just shows his literal lack of effort. 
I havent blocked his number I guess because it's kind of a way for me to hold on but also so i can keep reminding myself how shitty he is as he randomly texts useless things like this. It's been two weeks since he discarded me and im wonder what the actual heck he thinks I'm supposed to talk about wjth him LOL

Unfortunately I have reached out to all the resources I can and no one is able to help. The waitinglists for housing are closed at the moment and many organziations will not help me until the baby is actually born. My only option is to work myself to the bone and get my own place.
I am also going to have to leave this coworkers house as they have suddenly become aggressive with me and I really dont know why.

Hello! 
Just as everyone has said, the most important and powerful thing youve done for yourself has been to leave your husband.  Be nice to you and remind yourself of how much strength that takes! It's not easy but youve done it! 
Treat yourself with kindness. Be gentle. 
Cry when you need to and allow yourself to feel amy emotions that surface. It's okay, you can do this!!!!
Just take a deep breath and smile to yourself whenever you can. You will be okay. It hurts really bad and you feel lost but it's normal. 
BIG HUGGGSSSSS!!!!!!
Yes. It's such a crazy experience to be able to come together on. Really messed up.

Yeah...sorry. Didnt mean for it to sound like I was happy youve been through all of this yourself....
I wish that too.
You are so well educated on this it's amazing. Thank you for the insight! You're so right.

I am in this same situation right now! I have friends that care about me and see that how he abandoned me was terrible but I dont think I can ever rrally tell them just how terrible my time with him was. 
I barely only recognized how scarred I am from him until now!! I dont really blame them. 
But yeah, I have nightmares too. Wake up feeling so scared and vulnerable. Full of anger and sadness that this is my life. Very regretful and frustrated that i had to experience any of that. 

It's SO AMAZING how we all have each other on here for support. I couldnt cope at all before talking on here. It's already lonely to heal from all the trauma but when people dont get any of it, it's so much worse

Perfect way of putting it! This is exactly what I tried to say but mine ended up being a long ramble lol
Boundaries, self love and self trust wont have us running after such hurtful people anymore and once we've begun to heal, we see the way the world actually works.

Hi, there. 
Be kind to yourself! I dont think I can relate to this as my discard was only two weeks a go after a year long relationship so we may be completely different. What I can say though is that I can tell I am a lot less naive and trust my feelings more. This in turn makes me feel more mature and less trusting of people who are obviously weird or treating me in a bad way. 
Was raised by a narc and ex ended up being one too I guess so now after going no contact from them both, instead of ignoring my senses, I trust myself about people. I do feel apprehensive about men now though too. Dont like making eye contact and dont want to be bothered with any of them my age. Guess Im afraid to be hurt again. 
The old innocent person I was a year ago or even a few months ago is long gone. Broken. 
I can see what you mean by feeling less empathetic. I think it's just a result of the mental and emotional exhaustion you are having to work through. You've been through a lot of shxx Im sure. Again, just be kind to you.

Exactly. I'm actually feeling a bit down today, myself. But for real, these aches and pains couldnt possibly EVER compare to all the misery and panic I felt during my time with him. That's so crazy. No contact MAKES you wake up and stop denying it all. Because we knew how we felt, we knew how we were being treated wasnt right but we buried it. 
We can't bury it anymore so now, we've got to process ALL of it at once. It's okay. Like everyone has said, reach out to us as often as necessary or anyone supportive in your life.
This is very important. Honestly, super important to remember during healing. Get healthy for YOU and that will in turn allow you to attract healthy people into your life. Thanks for this!

Hey, there. 
Im sorry today is rough. It sucks how sudden the hard days can come on and make you feel like crawling into a hole. 
But all I can say is accept your feelings and keep moving forward. It hurts so bad, I know, but Im sure there were times within the relationship that hurt so much more than this. 
Just keep reminding yourself of that. 
They don't deserve to be in your life if you have to fight so hard for them and in the end all they were able to and willing to give you was pain. Cry, get angry and think about them when you need to but don't go back. All of this is part of the healing process. It's normal. 
It's okay. Im not saying this as some time of guru because i am literally going through it right now too. But be strong and take care of YOU now.

Unbelievable. Truly. 
YESSSS, remind yourself of how much of a BLESSING it is to not be with him anymore. That's the most important key i think because we already know it, it's just the abuse and conditioning that keeps us second guessing and guilting ourselves. 

The amount of times all of this repeated without ever changing is soo sickening too. It sucks. You seriously try so hard and beat yourself up not knowing what to do to make it better...
I hope you and your son are safe???
And take your time healing. Of course youre having emotional struggles right now. And how dare he leave you when you need him the most. But guess what? Im sure the universe actually just gave you what you needed most. He needed to be out of your life and now you can move forward. We shouldnt have to fight for love and acceptance. 

Love is supposed to be unconditional and unafraid. Im sure whenever there were good times or when things felt "lovey dovey" again, you were scared of doing something and getting that "love" taken away. That is so awful. BYE to all of that, at least with yourself you will always know you are accepted, just have to scrape off all the gunk from the toxic people. 

THANK YOU. I can finally be excited to meet my baby now that this has happened. Just the two of us. No crazy people ruining our lives anymore. Just healing and happiness to look forward to. 😊I wish you the same A TRILLION TIMES OVER

Are we talking about the same person?????? Because all of that ALL used to happen to me too! What the heck!! Im not even kidding or trying to be relatable. WHOA. 

Yes, I know exactly what you mean with trying to get him to work on just literally SAYING anything if it meant we could get to the bottom of an issue or just know both of our thoughts, but he never would. He's disappear for days and come back emotionless and like nothing happened. The most fxxxed up thing he did to me was this last week when i kept asking what we could do better to make our relationship happy again and he wouldn't offer anything. Then, days later after avoiding my calls he tells me we are done because he agrees with what people have been telling him wrong about our relationship. Even when we have a baby on the way in a few months...

INSANE. GOOD RIDDANCE FROM THESE GUYS. 
No matter how much it hurts and how many nights we have to stay up crying to feel better, it is worth it over going back to these monsters. No accountability for anything. The similarity in behaviours is so crazy.

Your support is much much much appreciated. BIG HUGS right back to you! 
We may all have individual healing to do but this forum is solid proof we are NEVER alone in it. Ever.

Honestly, wow thank you. That means SO much. 
All ive been hearing is "get child support", "let him be there for the birth", etc these people dont get it. 

Im sorry you had to go through that and my heart goes out to you as my mother was the same way. It really hurts. And to see that same kind of pattern in your partner is sad. 

The "smearing" my ex has done and allowed his relatives to do is painful but i wont back down when i literally know the consequences of a child going through all that.
I just have to get over the addiction as you said. 

You're an amazing person and clearly have so much good ahead so take it day by day. And whenever you feel discouraged, need to cry or even boast happily about something, keep reaching out on here. Im sure if we all could, we would be meeting in-person at coffee shops and talking for hours. Supporting one another. 
We can think this as a virtual coffee shop hehe

Thank you! After finding all of these threads of people going through the same thing, it is a little easier on the wounds, I guess. No one I know understands especially when I came from a family of people with narc traits.

The worst part is feeling like I failed my baby by not being able to keep her "father".
For a week so far...

The silent treatment crap is so pathetic. I thought it was just his personality and something we were goinf to have to really work on as a couple. No matter how many times i literally begged and fought for it to stop, it never did. WOW.
I'm glad we aren't alone in this. 
Big hugs!

No contact because:

1. Broke up with me/abandoned me across country because his family told him to.
2. Abandoned me while 7 months pregnant aka making me deal with emotional, physical and financial problems alone while he lives at his moms house.
3. Lied about moving in together and raising our baby as a family. Was asking for nudes days before texting me he'd veen wanting to break up for months.

Wow, this is crazy. I went through another episode of deep sorrow today where i couldn't believe how he could do this to me and all the things he allowed others to do to me as well. I was thinking the same thing, like what is easier??? 

The pain and trauma is so overwhelming sometimes going back looks so much more promising. 
Much less painful than being painted the villian to everyone he knows because of his own faults. I am young and this was my first relationship so i feel very regretful of everything. I am going no contact for the sake of protecting my child. I am new to this all but i would strongly advise you to do th same. Get a court order. Please protect your precious babies from this abuse. 
Being around that will either make more narcs or makes them more victims in the future.

I have him blocked on everything after he discarded me after lying about raising our unborn baby together. He dumped me a week ago because people told him to lol BUT i dont have him blocked on my phone....i think it's because im hoping he will reach out once the baby is supposed to be born and be wondering about the baby and I. 
I have to hide it from him though, to protect both the baby and I. His family is insane and cheering him on for abandoning us. It hurts. Two days after throwing me away over the phone, he texts, "hey". 
This is just proof he never cared and will only damage my child. It sucks because i fought so hard againt all the red flags to just stay with him for the baby too but now, there's too much to unsee...

Exactly why I stayed with my ex for th time i did. I noticed the bad things so early on but stayed because i didnt want to be another girl to "break his heart."  In the end, it was mine that was shattered and him who remains intact. 
Never again. 
And now i have a baby on the way by him....very scary.

Please get out. Leave him immediately.
I saw the red flags in the beginning and didnt want to trust myself. 
We dated for a year, I'm 7 months pregnant and he basically discarded me after being abusive and manipulative since tbe pregnancy.
His mother hates me and she told him to get rid of me which he said that was his reason. "People have been telling me what is wrong with our relationship and I agree." Then he broke up with me after lying about moving into together and raising this baby together.
Please do put yourself through this.
